## Scope

Describe the bounded user result and exclusions.

## Evidence

- [ ] Deterministic tests updated
- [ ] Release build/test result recorded
- [ ] `git diff --check` passes
- [ ] No secrets, private payloads or live trading calls
- [ ] Evidence records `NOT RUN` items
- [ ] Independent review completed

## Risk and rollback

State safety impact, residual debt and recoverable rollback point.
